title: Discovery Scan Summary
description: Summary of a single active [discovery](../docs/specs/discovery.md) scan generation, reporting unique identifiers and deviations from expected behavior

scanner_device_id.description: Device ID of the scanner publishing the discovery scan

generation.description: Generational timestamp identifying the active discovery scan

active_count.description: Number of positive active discovery event items received for this scan

depth.description: Inferred enumeration depth from observed event fields; omitted when unknown

status.description: Scan validation outcome; omitted when the scan passed with no errors or warnings

missing_event_nos.description: Expected positive sequence numbers missing from the received event stream

duplicate_event_nos.description: Positive sequence numbers received more than once

duplicate_addrs.description: Family addresses reported multiple times within the same scan

duplicate_networks.description: Networks reported multiple times within the same buckets scan

extra_addrs.description: Discovered family addresses not matching any modeled site device

errors.description: Validation errors recorded for this scan session

warnings.description: Validation warnings recorded for this scan session
